description: This is a unit test class for MessageHeadersBuilder, testing various functionalities such as creating instances, handling headers, exception cases, and setting specific headers like feature id, status code, and timestamp.

classes.name: MessageHeadersBuilderTest
classes.description: Unit test class for MessageHeadersBuilder, testing creation, header manipulation, and validation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the MessageHeadersBuilder instance before each test.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullDirection
methods.description: Tests that creating an instance with null direction throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Tests that creating an instance with null ThingId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullSubject
methods.description: Tests that creating an instance with null subject throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithEmptySubject
methods.description: Tests that creating an instance with empty subject throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithInvalidSubject
methods.description: Tests that creating an instance with invalid subject throws DittoHeaderInvalidException.

methods.name: createInstanceFromMinimalMap
methods.description: Tests creating MessageHeaders from a minimal valid map.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceFromMapWithoutThingId
methods.description: Tests that missing ThingId in header map throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceFromEmptyJsonObject
methods.description: Tests that an empty JSON object for headers throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: tryToSetEmptyFeatureId
methods.description: Tests that setting an empty featureId throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: tryToSetUnknownStatusCode
methods.description: Tests that setting an unknown HTTP status code throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: setStatusCodeAsIntWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests setting a known HTTP status code.

methods.name: tryToPutMapWithInvalidDittoHeader
methods.description: Tests that invalid Ditto header value throws DittoHeaderInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToRemoveMandatoryHeader
methods.description: Tests that removing mandatory headers throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: tryToRemoveMandatoryHeaderBySettingToNull
methods.description: Tests that setting mandatory header to null throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToPutInvalidHeader
methods.description: Tests that setting an invalid timestamp header throws DittoHeaderInvalidException.

methods.name: setTimestampAsString
methods.description: Tests setting a timestamp header with a valid ISO 8601 string.
